summary.intent: Add two new phases (59 and 60) to the CipherBox ROADMAP extending the v1.1 hardening block after Phase 58: Phase 59 for FUSE IPNS Verify/Publish Hardening & Cleanup, and Phase 60 for IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout (Desktop + API).
summary.outcome: Both phases were scaffolded and fully enriched in ROADMAP.md with Goal/Requirements/Scope/Verification-gate sections, REQUIREMENTS.md was updated with HARD-10 and HARD-11 entries, STATE.md roadmap evolution log was updated, and all changes were committed on a new branch separate from PR #552.

repo: Phases follow HARD-NN requirement ID convention; HARD-07/08/09 covered Phases 56/57/58, so 59/60 use HARD-10/11
`gsd-tools query phase.add` creates only skeletal ROADMAP entries (Goal/Depends on/Plans stubs) — full enrichment with Scope, captured-todos, and Verification gate must be done manually afterward
`phase.add` automatically creates `.gitkeep` files in the new phase directories, making them git-trackable without manual intervention
The Execution Order section in ROADMAP.md is NOT automatically extended by `phase.add` — must be manually appended after scaffolding
REQUIREMENTS.md has a mapping table, coverage count, and header range that must all be updated together when adding new requirements
Phase 59 bridges to Phase 60 via the unified first-publish IPNS embedded-sequence convention (FUSE 0 vs SDK 1)

code.finding: File branch uses `wrap_key(...).ok()` which swallows a key-wrap error and publishes a FilePointer with `ipns_private_key_encrypted: None`; should propagate the error like the Folder branch at lines 153-157 (targeted in Phase 59)
File-side re-resolution only triggers on `modified_at` change, not on a changed `file_meta_ipns_name`, allowing a file to retain stale CID/keys after identity reset (targeted in Phase 59)
Four `resolve_ipns` call sites (~43, ~110, ~177, ~236) that bypass verified resolution — targeted in Phase 60 to route through a verified resolver with fail-closed parity
Two additional unverified `resolve_ipns` sites (~21, ~250) targeted in Phase 60

API publish/resolve hot path re-verifies IPNS signatures even for DB-authoritative records this server just signed; Phase 60 targets a short-TTL verified-record cache keyed by (ipnsName, sequenceNumber, signature), while still verifying DHT/externally-sourced records

workflow: Always branch off main before adding phases so scaffolding commits don't pollute in-flight PRs (here, kept off PR #552)
Re-read ROADMAP.md after `phase.add` tool calls — the file is mutated by the CLI, invalidating any previously-read content
The `state.add-roadmap-evolution` handler is SDK-only and may not be available via bare CLI invocation; direct STATE.md edit is the fallback
ROADMAP integrity should be verified after bulk edits by checking line count and phase heading count to catch silent truncation

friction: `gsd:phase` (phase.add) only scaffolds skeletal entries — every field beyond Goal/Depends on/Plans required manual multi-edit enrichment to match the Phase 56–58 format
ROADMAP.md was modified between the initial read and the enrichment edits (by phase.add calls), causing the first edit attempt to fail and requiring a re-read mid-task
The Execution Order section was not updated by phase.add, requiring a separate manual edit to append phases 59 and 60
`state.add-roadmap-evolution` CLI handler was unavailable in this context, falling back to direct STATE.md editing
A garbled clause in the Phase 60 STATE.md evolution entry required a follow-up corrective edit
